Ivys, you find yourself at the banks of a massive river. A river that was once small and shallow, but as you recognize it, you realize you have tried to cross many times before. Every time you fail the banks grow farther apart, and you have failed many many times. You have tried over the course of thousands of years, and every time you get a little farther from crossing. You flail and sputter as you drown, you fall to the depths, and yet you rise again. In every life, you find the river. An old man waits for you on the other side, music fills the world, but every song must end.
